acceptance.gate: Phase 5 gate G5 per master-plan v2.1 §9: summed link RF3 within 5% of -46.946 kN.

boundary_conditions.contact_scope: Abaqus/Standard surface-to-surface ONLY; no general contact, no ALL EXTERIOR, no node-to-surface, no self-contact (main/secondary must be different bodies)
boundary_conditions.friction: isotropic penalty, mu = 0.3, max elastic-slip fraction 5.0e-3, finite sliding, default normal behavior, include surface thickness
boundary_conditions.initial_state: all three interactions active from Initial step; no overclosure adjustment, no user-specified initial clearance

parts: connecting pin (cylindrical section: strong steel; two end caps: weak steel)

loads.procedure: Static, General; geometric nonlinearity On; initial increment 0.1, minimum 1e-8
loads.type: contact-driven load transfer: hinge pulled while link held; load transferred through the pin

strong_steel.hardening: two-point linear-extrapolated: 2000 MPa @ eps_p = 0 → 200000 MPa @ eps_p = 10

weak_steel.hardening: two-point linear-extrapolated: 1500 MPa @ eps_p = 0 → 150000 MPa @ eps_p = 10

materials.type: isotropic elasticity + two-point linearly extrapolated plastic hardening (both steels)

mesh_sweep.boundary_tessellation: resolved by the mesher from geometry and element size (no longer user-set)

provenance.reference_doc_sections: §1.1 purpose, §1.2 supported contact scope, §1.3 SFM3D3 surface-layer mechanism, §1.4 materials + analysis settings, §1.5 contact definition, §1.6 discretization, §1.7 output + RF3 result

reference_values.summed_link_RF3_note: Summed link reaction force at the END of the prescribed displacement (Fig. 2 in source). No accompanying CSVs in generated-downloads.
